title: Chapter 179 Becoming A Wild Guard
content:
Chapter 179 Becoming A Wild Guard

However, Lu Daosheng just sneered a few times and did not answer the blood clan man.

"ah!!"

A scream rang out from the void.

The next moment, the blood clan man completely turned into a bloody rain, and blood spilled into the void.

Standing in the void, Lu Daosheng glanced around, his face cold.

"Where are you?"

Lu Daosheng's voice resounded through the void.

"Senior, we will never cross that chasm."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded and then turned around and left.

After Lu Daosheng left, several phantoms slowly emerged from the void.

Looking at the direction where Lu Daosheng left, a phantom said, "Class leader, are we really willing to be willing to do this?"

boom!

As soon as he finished speaking, the phantom with the strongest aura immediately took action.

"If you are seeking death, don't implicate us!"

"Tell the tribe members that in the future, be more low-key, there are strong people in this world that are far beyond our imagination."

The phantom slowly said, then disappeared directly from the spot.

.........

At the same time, outside the deserted city.

A large number of people slowly came from the void towards the deserted city.

The leader is the empress of the Divine Dynasty, Yan Lingyun.

But from today on, the title of the Emperor of the God Dynasty has become a thing of the past.

"I've seen Mrs.

Awei Anxing and others led everyone in Huangcheng to go out to greet him personally.

"mother!"

At this time, Lu Xue walked towards Yan Lingyun from the crowd.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun smiled, then pulled Lu Xue and took everyone in the Divine Dynasty into the deserted city.

Suddenly, the entire Xuanling Star Domain vibrated.

"The unprecedentedly powerful Divine Empire has actually joined the Huangcheng. It seems that Huangcheng will be the master of the world from now on."

Countless practitioners were immediately filled with emotion.

Once upon a time, they thought that the Huangcheng and the Divine Dynasty would provoke a century-old war to fight for the world.

But I never expected that this would end.

Somewhere, in the former Fire Spirit Star Domain Hall.

Yan Yan looked bitter.

"Damn it, it's actually the ending."

On the side, Hun Yue, who was in the ancient star field, also smiled bitterly.

This Divine Dynasty and Huangcheng were a family, and they could not have thought that they would be killed at that time.

At the beginning, they actually wanted to let the two forces fight. After a long time, they found that they were clowns.

"What should I do now?"

Hunyue asked.

Hearing this, Yan Yan was stunned for a moment, and then said with a serious expression: "What should I do? What else can I do? Of course I will fight to the end!"

"I, Yan Yan, won't surrender to them so much!"

Seeing Yan Yan like this, Hun Yue was shocked.

"Brother Yan, I didn't expect that you were so tough, okay! Since that's the case, I'm willing to fight against the war with you!"

I thought Yan Yan would immediately become more popular and chose to join the deserted city.

Yan Yan's wave surprised Hunji.

Immediately, the two hit it off and prepared to start accumulating power.

After getting along.

"Mr. Yan, where are you going?"

A subordinate looked at Yan Yan who suddenly carried his luggage, with confusion in his eyes.

"Fuck, do you care? Get out!"

Immediately, Yan Yan left the Fire Spirit Star Domain without looking back and headed towards the direction of the deserted city.

In the deserted city.

Since the Shen Dynasty joined the Huangcheng City, Huangcheng ushered in the most prosperous period in history.

The strength of the entire wasteland city began to soar.

In order to join the Huangcheng, countless powerful people almost squeezed their heads.

This day.

"Sir, I want to settle in the deserted city, too."

Yan Yan stuffed a ring into the hands of a manager and said kindly.

Looking at the ring in his hand, the manager looked expressionless, "Not everyone can live in the deserted city now. There are many people in front of you."

Hearing this, Yan Yan's mouth twitched slightly.

Is it so difficult to join Huangcheng?

At this time, the manager suddenly said, "If you want to join Huangcheng, you can become a Huangwei first."

"With your strength, there is still a great chance of becoming a Huangwei. After becoming a Huangwei, if you want to settle in Huangcheng, you will have much greater chance of becoming an Huangcheng."

Hearing this, Yan Yan looked surprised.

"Thank you, thank you."

Immediately, under the guidance of this kind-hearted person, Yan Yan came to the registration office of Huangwei.

"Hunyue! Why are you here!!"

I saw a familiar figure queuing in the registration office of the deserted guard.

It’s not someone else, it’s the Hung Yue who was discussing and fighting together not long ago.

When he heard someone calling him, Hun Yue frowned slightly. He turned around and saw Yan Yan.

"Uh, haha, Brother Yan, what a coincidence."

At this moment, it was a bit embarrassing.

After all, I agreed to fight together, but now I am secretly coming to the deserted city.

But suddenly, Hun Yue looked slightly stunned.

"Brother Yan, what did you come here for?"

Hun Yue reacted and then asked Yan Yan back.

Suddenly, it was Yan Yan's turn to be embarrassed.

Seeing Yan Yan's eyes dodging, Hun Yue immediately understood.

Haha, now, no one will tell who will come.

The two of them were so tactful that they didn't say anything, they just lined up silently.

"Next."

Go ahead.

"Name, where is the person, what realm."

"Sir, let's get into the ancient star field before you go down, and get into the divine emperor realm."

Immediately, a breath of the God Emperor Realm slowly overflowed from the body.

"Oh? God Emperor Realm."

The guard in charge of registration was slightly surprised, but only a little.

"You can stay. Someone will investigate your identity at that time. Once there is no problem, you will be a qualified guard."

The guard said in a calm voice.

Hearing this, Hun Yue nodded repeatedly, "Thank you, sir, thank you, sir."

Facing the guard in front of him, Hun Yue was very respectful, not only because of his identity, but also because he was also a strong man in the realm of God Emperor.

His aura was even stronger than his own.

This desert city has become so strong now that any guard in the desert has the realm of God Emperor.

No wonder it can sweep across all the star fields.

Hun Yue was shocked and then stepped aside to wait.

After a while, it was Yan Yan's turn.

"Sir, I am the former master of the Fire Spirit Hall in the Fire Spirit Star Field, Yan Yan, in the realm of God Emperor."

Yan Yan took the initiative to speak.

Seeing another God Emperor, the Wilderness Guard was stunned for a moment, then said: "Then you go to the side and wait."

"Thank you, sir."

I don't know how long it took.

A member of the Root Organization came here with a jade slip.

The Wilderness Guard took the jade slip and then read it.

"Hun Yue."

"Sir."

Hun Yue was a little nervous and hurried forward.

The Wilderness Guard glanced at Hun Yue, then smiled and said: "I didn't expect that you had come to the Wilderness City a long time ago."

"Yes, from now on, you are also one of us."

Then, the Wilderness Guard handed Hun Yue a token representing the identity of the Wilderness Guard.

Looking at the token in his hand, Hun Yue was moved.

This is a stable job!

"Thank you, sir, from now on, Hun Yue will work hard for the Wilderness City until his death."

At the same time, the information about the rules and treatment of the Wilderness Guard was also transmitted from the Wilderness Guard token to Hun Yue's sea of consciousness.

Seeing the treatment of the Wilderness Guard, Hun Yue was so excited that he didn't know what to do.

This, this is just an ordinary wilderness guard, but he is even more powerful than me when I was still a big brother in the ancient star field.

Woo woo woo, what kind of life did I live before.
